repos.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Claude Code, Claude Design. OpenAI - ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking, GPT 5.5 Instant, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.

aiSummary.summary: 该项目致力于收集并公开 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI 等主流 AI 模型的系统提示词。它详细记录了 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok 等产品的底层指令，并提供版本更新与差异对比，帮助开发者了解 AI 的行为规则。
aiSummary.summary_en: Collection of leaked system prompts for major AI models like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于 AI 安全研究人员、开发者及安全专家，用于研究 AI 模型的底层行为、限制及安全边界。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Researchers and developers analyze the hidden instructions and behaviors of various AI models.

repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

aiSummary.summary: 该项目为 AI 编码代理提供生产级工程技能，将资深工程师的工作流、质量门控和最佳实践封装成技能。包含 8 个斜杠命令覆盖全生命周期开发，支持自动生成计划和测试驱动开发，适用于 Claude Code、Cursor 等多种 AI 编码工具。
aiSummary.summary_en: A collection of production-grade engineering workflows and best practices for AI coding agents.
aiSummary.useCase: 为 AI 编码代理提供标准化的工程工作流与最佳实践，提升代码质量与开发效率。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To enforce production-grade engineering workflows and best practices across AI coding agents.

repos.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows.

aiSummary.summary: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 的隐私优先 AI 会议助手，支持实时转录、说话人分离和 Ollama 总结。它完全在本地运行，无需云端，确保数据主权，适合需要数据安全和合规的企业及个人用户。
aiSummary.summary_en: Rust-based local AI meeting assistant for privacy-focused transcription and summarization.
aiSummary.useCase: 适合对数据隐私要求高、需要本地化部署的企业及个人用户。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Self-hosted meeting transcription and summarization for privacy-conscious users.

repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.

aiSummary.summary: RuView 是一个基于 Rust 开发的 WiFi 传感平台，利用信道状态信息（CSI）将普通 WiFi 信号转化为空间智能。它能在无摄像头、无穿戴设备的情况下，穿透墙壁检测人体存在、呼吸心率、活动状态及睡眠质量，并支持与 Home Assistant、Apple Home 等主流智能家居生态无缝集成。
aiSummary.summary_en: Rust-based WiFi sensing platform turning radio signals into spatial intelligence for presence detection and vital sign monitoring.
aiSummary.useCase: 无摄像头智能家居存在感监测与生命体征追踪
aiSummary.useCase_en: Turn ordinary WiFi into a spatial intelligence system to detect presence, vitals, and activity through walls without cam

repos.description: Taste-Skill - gives your AI good taste. stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop

aiSummary.summary: Taste-Skill 是一个为 AI 代理设计的“反垃圾”前端框架，旨在提升 AI 生成的界面质量。它提供可移植的技能包，包含增强的布局、排版和动画设计，帮助 AI 避免生成枯燥的通用 UI。项目还包含图像生成技能，可与 ChatGPT Images 等工具配合使用，生成设计参考板，最终由 Codex 或 Claude Code 等代码生成器实现。
aiSummary.summary_en: A JavaScript framework providing design skills to upgrade AI-generated interfaces and prevent generic output.
aiSummary.useCase: 为 AI 代理提供高质量的前端设计参考，辅助生成美观的 Web 或移动端界面代码。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Enhance AI coding workflows by providing design standards and reference boards for frontend implementation.

repos.description: 345 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (30+ Agents, 70+ custom commands, 330+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个为13个AI编程工具提供355+生产就绪技能、插件和代理技能的开源库。包含602个Python CLI脚本和711个参考模板，涵盖工程、营销、合规、研究等多个领域，支持Claude Code、Cursor等主流工具。
aiSummary.summary_en: A comprehensive library of 355+ production-ready skills and plugins for 13 AI coding agents.
aiSummary.useCase: 为AI编程助手提供领域专业知识，提升代码生成、文档编写及跨领域业务流程自动化能力。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To provide modular domain expertise and automation tools for developers using 13 different AI coding agents.

repos.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个为 Claude Code 用户设计的插件，允许在 Claude 工作流中直接调用 Codex 进行代码审查和任务委托。支持常规审查、对抗性审查及后台任务管理，需 Node.js 18.18+ 环境。
aiSummary.summary_en: Integrates OpenAI Codex into Claude Code for code reviews and task delegation.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于希望在 Claude Code 环境中集成 Codex 进行自动化代码审查和任务处理的开发者。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Allows Claude Code users to leverage OpenAI Codex for code reviews and task delegation.

repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个基于 Python 的 AI agent skill，能够跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 和全网搜索任意主题。它通过点赞、观看量及真实资金投入等真实互动数据进行评分，并由 AI 代理综合生成总结。旨在替代传统编辑筛选，提供基于大众关注度和市场资金的搜索结果。
aiSummary.summary_en: An AI agent skill that aggregates and synthesizes data from Reddit, X, YouTube, and Polymarket based on real-time engagement.
aiSummary.useCase: 快速获取跨多平台的最新热点话题及深度总结。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Research any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, and Polymarket to synthesize a grounded summary based on real-time engagem

repos.description: agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.

aiSummary.summary: Herdr 是一个运行在终端内的多路复用器，用于统一管理所有编码代理。它提供真实的终端视图，支持状态可视化（阻塞/工作/完成），并具备类似 tmux 的分屏、标签页和持久化会话功能。支持 SSH 远程连接，无 GUI 依赖，轻量级且可脚本化。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Rust terminal multiplexer for managing coding agents with real terminals and state tracking.
aiSummary.useCase: 需要在单终端窗口中高效管理和监控多个 AI 编码代理的开发者。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Manage multiple coding agents in a single terminal window with real terminal views and state tracking.

repos.description: Give Claude the ability to watch any video. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes, hands it all to Claude.

aiSummary.summary: 该项目通过下载、提取帧和转录音频，赋予 Claude AI 观看视频的能力。支持零配置安装，自动处理字幕或调用 Whisper API。用户可利用它分析视频内容、诊断 Bug 或研究竞争对手策略。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Python plugin enabling Claude to watch, analyze, and answer questions about videos by extracting frames and transcribing audio.
aiSummary.useCase: 分析视频内容、诊断 Bug 或研究竞争对手策略
aiSummary.useCase_en: Allows users to analyze video content or diagnose bugs by having Claude watch, transcribe, and read frames of the media.

repos.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search

aiSummary.summary: Karakeep 是一款自托管的书签与笔记应用，支持链接、图片及 PDF。核心特色是利用 AI（LLM）自动生成标签、摘要及全文搜索，并支持本地模型。功能涵盖 OCR、浏览器插件、移动端、RSS 摘要、视频归档及防链接失效的完整页面归档，适合数据囤积者进行知识管理与协作。
aiSummary.summary_en: A self-hostable bookmark manager with AI-powered tagging and full-text search.
aiSummary.useCase: 适合个人或团队进行知识管理、数据囤积及高效整理网络资源。
aiSummary.useCase_en: A self-hosted solution for organizing bookmarks, notes, and media with AI-driven tagging and search.

repos.description: The API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. 🔥

aiSummary.summary: Firecrawl 是一个用于大规模搜索、抓取和与网络交互的 API。它将网页内容转换为干净的 Markdown 或结构化数据，专为 AI 应用设计。项目覆盖 96% 的网络，支持 JS 页面抓取，具备代理集成、媒体解析及交互功能，提供开源和托管服务，旨在简化 AI 应用的数据获取流程。
aiSummary.summary_en: A scalable API for searching, scraping, and interacting with the web to generate LLM-ready data.
aiSummary.useCase: AI 应用数据获取、网页爬取与实时代理
aiSummary.useCase_en: Extracting clean markdown and structured data from websites for AI applications.

repos.description: Show usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, without having to login.

aiSummary.summary: CodexBar 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，专为追踪多种 AI 编码工具（如 OpenAI、Claude、Copilot 等）的使用配额、重置时间和成本而设计。它支持多种接入方式，无需存储密码，帮助开发者规划任务并监控余额。
aiSummary.summary_en: A macOS menu bar app that tracks usage stats for various AI coding providers without requiring login.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要同时监控多个 AI 编码助手配额与成本的 macOS 开发者。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Monitor AI coding limits and credits across multiple providers directly from the macOS menu bar.

repos.description: A lightweight, lightning-fast, in-process vector database

aiSummary.summary: Zvec 是阿里巴巴开源的轻量级、极速的进程内向量数据库。支持稠密与稀疏向量、原生全文搜索及混合检索。具备 DiskANN 索引、WAL 持久化及多读单写并发机制，专为嵌入式应用设计，无需外部服务器即可实现毫秒级大规模相似性搜索。
aiSummary.summary_en: Alibaba's high-performance in-process vector database featuring hybrid retrieval, full-text search, and disk-based indexing.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要高性能、低延迟相似性搜索的嵌入式应用场景，如 RAG、推荐系统和语义搜索。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Embed a production-grade vector database into applications for low-latency similarity search and hybrid retrieval.

repos.description: 😎 Awesome lists about all kinds of interesting topics

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个汇集了各类主题精选资源列表的集合，涵盖了平台、编程语言、前后端开发、大数据、安全、硬件等广泛领域。它旨在作为发现优质项目和学习资源的综合目录，帮助开发者高效获取相关领域的知识。
aiSummary.summary_en: A curated collection of awesome lists covering various topics like programming, platforms, and development tools.
aiSummary.useCase: 用于发现和学习各类技术主题的优质资源与工具。
aiSummary.useCase_en: A comprehensive resource for finding curated lists of tools, libraries, and resources across various development topics.

aiSummary.summary: Gas Town 是一个用 Go 编写的多智能体工作区管理器，旨在协调 Claude Code、Copilot 等 AI 编码智能体。它通过 git-backed hooks 持久化工作状态，解决智能体重启丢失上下文的问题，内置邮箱和交接机制，支持管理 20-30 个智能体，实现可靠的协作。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Go-based multi-agent workspace manager for coordinating AI coding agents with persistent state.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要管理多个 AI 编码智能体协作、防止上下文丢失的复杂开发场景。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Coordinate multiple AI coding agents across different projects while maintaining persistent context and state.
